title: Pet Fiasco v26.11.0 — Exploration Update: Part 1
size: Tauri Android APK, Tauri Sideloadly IPA, macOS DMG, Windows ZIP, Linux archive, and web ZIP
changelog: Exploration Update Part 1 expands the pet world to 72 by 90 world units
Visit the vet, bed, toy yard, game station, pond, cottage, tree, park, and garden
Use E or the mobile Action button to enter places and perform real care actions
See the pet family together, with a larger selected pet and tap-to-switch companions
Walk into the food bowl to eat while retaining jump and bird-flight interactions
Android and iPhone/iPad downloads are mobile-only Tauri shells that load the hosted game
Moved hosting, login, and cloud saves to a healthy Firebase project after the former project was suspended
Enabled email/password and Google sign-in with private cloud saves
Added native Windows and Linux desktop packages; Windows supports cloud accounts and Linux keeps local progress
